column1: # One row per heavy-test call site: heavytest.Require(t, <criterion>) declares the
# test heavy and skips it unless GOPI_HEAVY_TESTS is truthy, so `go test ./...` and
# the merge/verify path stay smoke-only. `make test-heavy` runs them.
# Criterion (why this test is heavy — would a reasonable person not want it on a
# shared machine while other work proceeds?):
#   disk-fixture    minutes of real device work (ledger/scratch fsync per fixture)
#   wide-parallel   spawns concurrent processes sweeping the same tree
#   device-exec     drives a real external process (browser/daemon/git) end to end
#   host-condition  verdict depends on ambient host state (wall clock/sudo/load)
#   e2e-io          end-to-end contract cost dominated by host/network I/O
# and the code cannot drift. Measured baseline: the 2026-09-16 stream
# that set minus the gate packages (internal/standards, internal/stylegate),
# which must stay on the smoke path so a merge cannot land with its gates unrun.
# RE-DERIVED 2026-10-28 at ef09449: the merge lane's own tests were retired
# (5a9af79, "test(merge): 退役 merge 路线的 95 个测试文件"), so 37 rows named a
# source file that no longer exists in the tree and the gate reported them as
# STALE. Those 37 were deleted and nothing else was touched — this table ratchets
# down with the code, which is the whole point of asserting both directions.
# The count is measured, not asserted here: the checked-in table carried 169
# 132, and every surviving row still names a live `heavytest.Require(` call site
# (the gate is the proof, not this comment). No row was judged heavy by hand in
# this change: it only removed rows whose test no longer exists.
